verdict.rationale: llamafile's CLI docs mention an HTTP server mode that exposes an 'API' alongside the Web UI (llamafile-docs-9, llamafile-docs-5), giving programmatic access beyond the chat UI, but there is no dedicated API reference, endpoint schema, or OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json). missing for 10: explicit API endpoint documentation, OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent confirmation of API usage beyond the brief server-flag mention.
